convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, pen interactive Export scale 2 (default) vs Playwright deviceScaleFactor-2 captures of the NORMALIZED prototype clipped at the rounded capture-root rect. Chromium 140.0.7339.16 headless-shell (playwright 1.55.0) launched with --disable-lcd-text --force-color-profile=srgb --font-render-hinting=none (grayscale AA aligned to the pen rasterizer, per the v001 round-6 finding). Protocol: reducedMotion:reduce, animation/transition freeze CSS, document.fonts.ready, states.json step drive, 2500ms deferred-timer settle, pointer parked at 0,0, EMPTY localStorage per state (fresh context). PROTOCOL DELTA vs v001: NO snap transform on the capture root - Chrome pixel-snaps box decorations at layout position BEFORE applying transforms, so a fractional-root snap transform shifts painted borders 0.5px into the targets (measured on the body-mounted dialogs); instead the clip is the ROUNDED root rect, extraction coordinates are relative to that rounded origin, and the .pen reproduces Chrome box-decoration rounding (round-half-up to CSS integers on HTML-derived rects; text and svg stay at painted fractional positions).
convergence.determinism: double-export verified at the committed path: all 28 frame exports byte-identical across two pen interactive sessions at @pen.dev/cli 0.3.5. The 26 carried frames additionally export byte-identical to the FE-2152 lock round exportSha256 values (author-machine reproduction verified 2026-09-04).
convergence.authoringMethod: frames generated from measured DOM geometry of the normalized prototype (v001 method): per-state Playwright walk emitting CSS-painting-order scenes (rects / word-level text runs / svg shapes in CSS-px space via getScreenCTM), token-bound by role at assembly; per-(family,size,weight,lineHeight) text-baseline calibration measured with the SAME glyph-top pixel estimator in both rasterizers (53 combos); Chrome-specific behaviors reproduced: box-decoration pixel snapping, text-overflow ellipsis character truncation, CSS-triangle carets, ::before/::after materialization (KPI top bar, sticky-cell cover, pick indicators), UA list markers (measured disc geometry), UA range-slider synthesis from the r92 .sf-range rules (the -webkit-slider-* pseudos are not resolvable via getComputedStyle), rotated text via rigid CTM mapping, z-index stacking-context hoisting, overflow clipping.

iterationHistory.result: 6/26 <= 1.0% (rest 1.04-2.19%) - initial authoring from measured scenes; same-round export-mechanics correction (frame clip:true - pen Export includes effect ink outside the frame box; infra, target sizes matched thereafter)

7/26 (worst 2.15%) - evidence fixes: CSS-triangle carets materialized as paths, text-overflow ellipsis truncation, z-index>0 stacking-context hoist to root paint order (popovers/tooltips/sticky cells), tight bbox for gradient-filled paths (the detail-chart fade had normalized to the full-frame bbox)
21/26 (worst 1.36%) - Chrome box-decoration pixel snapping (round-half-up to CSS integers) applied to HTML-derived rects; isolated from the KPI top-bar 0.5px band evidence

25/26 (worst 1.27%) - baseline calibration v2 (same-pixel-estimator browser-vs-pen, rangeTop-anchored; the tight line-height combos were systematically 0.5-1px off), border-only pseudo materialization + color(srgb) parsing (pick indicators), UA list markers, rotated-chevron rigid mapping

26/26 <= 1.0% (worst 0.799%) - capture-protocol correction (transform-free rounded-clip roots; measurement side - the snap transform had been shifting Chrome box paint inside the TARGETS of the dialog states), r92 date-slider synthesis (track+thumb; the -webkit-slider-* pseudo styles resolve empty via getComputedStyle so the slider had been silently missing), rotated y-axis title (effective font scale under rotation), sub-threshold caret shape-integrity fix verified by a confirmation re-compare (26/26 before and after; no threshold chasing)

28/28 <= 1.0% (worst 0.799% carried, new frames 0.341%/0.154%) - two amendment frames authored from measured DOM of the normalized ORACLE STANDALONE; 26 carried frames re-verified, reproduce locked diffPct values exactly

amendmentRound.basis: Extension capture: the FE-2152 v002 lock (26 frames, captured 2026-09-03 against Bill's source r95 sha256:6a762cc6...) predates the FE-2162 amendment, which repointed the oracle to the byte-identical-carve ORACLE STANDALONE (sha256:2af7acfd..., hash-verified on disk before authoring) and added states comparison-loss-making-pe + secdata-loss-making-pe (28 total). The 26 pre-existing frames are carried VERBATIM (contract: 26/26 states render byte-identically between source and standalone) and re-verified honestly in this round: fresh normalization of the STANDALONE per the recorded recipe, fresh Playwright targets for all 28 states, full 28-state compare - the 26 carried frames reproduce their locked diffPct values exactly. The 2 new frames were authored with the same measured-DOM method, calibrated against the sibling frames (comparison-default / secdata-default): node-template validation reproduced the sibling regions 185/193 + 73/73 + bubbles 10/10 + input words 7/7 before authoring the new states. Converged in 1 honest iteration (0.341% / 0.154%).
amendmentRound.authoringDelta: Filler truth-layering: the sibling frames paint the td/th ::after fillers as full-height plain surface; the rendered truth shows the row bottom border and the header band gradient + borders-light hairline continuing under the fillers (sub-pixelmatch-threshold in the carried frames, sampled and verified in the targets). The two NEW frames paint the fillers as surface body + border strip (td) and band gradient + hairline strip (th) - same tokens, closer to the rendered truth (secdata-loss-making-pe lands at 0.154% vs the sibling's 0.238%). The carried frames are NOT retouched - they are the locked lock.
amendmentRound.seriesColorNote: Per token rule 3 / the recorded series-order judgment call: the amendment set is 'NVDA, RIVN', so NVDA is series index 0 and its bubble/label bind chart color-01 roles (fill #8951F01F / stroke #8951F02E / label #553295 = the r74 0.62 dark shade, all verified against the measured normalized rendering) - NOT the color-03 NVDA rides in the default 7-symbol set. RIVN draws NO bubble (rule 48 not-applicable branch); the omission is the state's contract.

normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: No family substitution required - the prototype already leads with Heebo (--font-ui) and Noto Serif (--font-serif). Serving source pinned: the Google Fonts stylesheet links are replaced by @font-face rules for the SAME repo TTFs the .pen embeds (pencil/designs/fonts/). Plus: .btn-primary, .segmented button, input, textarea, select gain font-family var(--font-ui) !important - these controls set no font-family and render UA Arial (prototype defect DC-2, carried from v001).
normalizationRecipe.notes: REPLAY MECHANICS: the injected <style> block must land at the LAST </body> occurrence (the prototype embeds an earlier </body> inside a JS string; v001 finding, still true at r95). The v001 UA-chrome dialog-button injections are RETIRED - the custom-axis dialog they patched was deleted at r82/P1-8; no UA-chrome button surface renders in the v002 contracted states. Range-slider synthesis (capture-side, not a prototype edit): the r92 .sf-range rules - track 3px accent pill full width, thumb 22px accent circle with 2px surface ring and 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.35) shadow - are drawn from the stylesheet because Chrome cannot resolve -webkit-slider-* pseudo styles through getComputedStyle. UA list markers (crypto-notes bullets): disc d=round(fontSize/3), right edge 11px before the li text start, top = baseline - d - 2 (measured against the rendered target). Unrendered-in-contracted-states variables injected for kit coherence but never measured: --seq*, --pos-mid, --pos-soft/--neg-soft, --accent-fill, --crosshair-stroke (legacy), --taupe-hover (hover-only), --panel-shadow/--tile-shadow (unrendered at r95 in contracted states), --hairline, --orange, --charcoal, --gauge-*, --cat1..15 (undashed template set), --hero-*, --accent-2/3/4, --sc-modal-* (kernel constants).
